texts.preamble: Jagdish Prasad vs State Of U.P. on 11 December, 2019 Author: Dinesh Kumar Singh Bench: Dinesh Kumar Singh High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench ?Court No. - 13 Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 337 of 2009 Revisionist :- Jagdish Prasad Opposite Party :- State of U.P. Counsel for Revisionist :- Pradeep Shukla Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A. Hon'ble Dinesh Kumar Singh,J. 1.
texts.facts: The facts of the case are that on 24.07.2001 at around 11.00 A.M. the Food Inspector, Koorebhar, Sultanpur had found the revisionist selling food items i.e. coriander powder, chili powder, turmeric powder and pan masala etc. He purchased three packets of 60 pouches each of Sanjog Pan Masala from the revisionist for Rs.180/- after disclosing his identity to the revisionist. The Food Inspector labeled all the packets and forwarded it to Chief Medical Officer, Sultanpur. The Public Analyst, in his report found that quantity of dissolved base in dilute Hydroelectric Acid was found to be more than .5% from the prescribed norms. Aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment, revisionist preferred appeal, which too was dismissed vide impugned judgement and order. 5. The incident is of the year 2001. More than 18 years have gone by since the samples were taken. The trial court judgment is dated 29.06.2009.
texts.arguments: 6. Learned counsel for the revisionist submits that the revisionist has undergone three months imprisonment and, he, therefore, submits that his sentence may be reduced to the sentence already undergone. 7. Considering the fact that the incident had happened 18 years before and also considering the judgement of the Supreme Court rendered in the case of Nand Lal v. State of Uttarakhand and others, 2010 (4) SCC 562, in which the Supreme Court after considering the age of the appellant in that case and taking into account the fact that the incident was very old, reduced the sentence to the period already undergone, interest of justice would meet if conviction of the accused-applicant is upheld and sentence is reduced to the period already undergone.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 6. Learned counsel for the revisionist submits that the revisionist has undergone three months imprisonment and, he, therefore, submits that his sentence may be reduced to the sentence already undergone. 7.
